            if (this.board[r][c] && this.getColor(this.board[r][c]) === this.turn) {
              all.push(...this.getLegalMoves(r, c));
            }
          }
        }
        return all;
      }
      makeMove(move, promotionChoice = 'Q') {
        const { from, to, isCastle, isEnPassant, isDoublePawn, isPromo } = move;
        const piece = this.board[from.r][from.c];
        const color = this.getColor(piece);
        let captured = this.board[to.r][to.c];

        this.history.push({
          board: this.cloneBoard(this.board),
          turn: this.turn,
          castling: { ...this.castling },
          enPassant: this.enPassant ? { ...this.enPassant } : null,
          capturedWhite: [...this.capturedWhite],
          capturedBlack: [...this.capturedBlack],
          move: { ...move, piece, captured, promotionChoice }
        });

        this.board[to.r][to.c] = piece;
        this.board[from.r][from.c] = null;

        if (isEnPassant) {
          const epRow = color === 'w' ? to.r + 1 : to.r - 1;
          captured = this.board[epRow][to.c];
          this.board[epRow][to.c] = null;
        }

        if (captured) {
          if (this.isWhite(captured)) this.capturedWhite.push(captured);
          else this.capturedBlack.push(captured);
        }

        if (isCastle) {
          if (isCastle === 'K') { this.board[7][5] = 'R'; this.board[7][7] = null; }
          else if (isCastle === 'Q') { this.board[7][3] = 'R'; this.board[7][0] = null; }
          else if (isCastle === 'k') { this.board[0][5] = 'r'; this.board[0][7] = null; }
          else if (isCastle === 'q') { this.board[0][3] = 'r'; this.board[0][0] = null; }
        }

        if (isPromo) {
          const promoPiece = color === 'w' ? promotionChoice.toUpperCase() : promotionChoice.toLowerCase();
          this.board[to.r][to.c] = promoPiece;
        }

        if (piece === 'K') { this.castling.K = false; this.castling.Q = false; }
        if (piece === 'k') { this.castling.k = false; this.castling.q = false; }
        if (from.r === 7 && from.c === 7) this.castling.K = false;
        if (from.r === 7 && from.c === 0) this.castling.Q = false;
        if (from.r === 0 && from.c === 7) this.castling.k = false;
        if (from.r === 0 && from.c === 0) this.castling.q = false;
        if (to.r === 7 && to.c === 7) this.castling.K = false;
        if (to.r === 7 && to.c === 0) this.castling.Q = false;
        if (to.r === 0 && to.c === 7) this.castling.k = false;
        if (to.r === 0 && to.c === 0) this.castling.q = false;

        if (isDoublePawn) {
          const epRow = color === 'w' ? from.r - 1 : from.r + 1;
          this.enPassant = { r: epRow, c: from.c };
        } else {
          this.enPassant = null;
        }

        this.turn = this.turn === 'w' ? 'b' : 'w';

        const oppMoves = this.getAllLegalMoves();
        const inCheck = this.isCheck(this.turn);
        let status = 'active';
        if (oppMoves.length === 0) {
          status = inCheck ? 'checkmate' : 'stalemate';
        }

        return { status, inCheck, captured, piece };
      }
      undo() {
        if (this.history.length === 0) return null;
        const last = this.history.pop();
        this.board = last.board;
        this.turn = last.turn;
        this.castling = last.castling;
        this.enPassant = last.enPassant;
        this.capturedWhite = last.capturedWhite;
        this.capturedBlack = last.capturedBlack;
        return last;
      }
    }

    // Controller & UI Binding
    const game = new MonsterHunterChess();
    const audio = new MonsterHunterAudio();
    let selectedSquare = null;
    let validMoves = [];
    let isFlipped = false;
    let pendingPromoMove = null;

    const boardEl = document.getElementById('chessBoard');
    const boardContainer = document.getElementById('boardContainer');
    const turnIndicator = document.getElementById('turnIndicator');
    const turnAvatar = document.getElementById('turnAvatar');
    const turnText = document.getElementById('turnText');
    const checkBadge = document.getElementById('checkBadge');
    const commentaryBanner = document.getElementById('commentaryBanner');
    const whiteCapturedTray = document.getElementById('whiteCapturedTray');
    const blackCapturedTray = document.getElementById('blackCapturedTray');
    const chkAutoRotate = document.getElementById('chkAutoRotate');
    const promoModal = document.getElementById('promoModal');
    const promoGrid = document.getElementById('promoGrid');
    const gameOverModal = document.getElementById('gameOverModal');
    const gameOverTitle = document.getElementById('gameOverTitle');
    const gameOverMsg = document.getElementById('gameOverMsg');

    function renderBoard() {
      boardEl.innerHTML = '';
      const inCheck = game.isCheck(game.turn);
      const kPos = inCheck ? game.findKing(game.board, game.turn) : null;

      for (let r = 0; r < 8; r++) {
        for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) {
          const sq = document.createElement('div');
          const isLight = (r + c) % 2 === 0;
          sq.className = `square ${isLight ? 'light' : 'dark'}`;
          sq.dataset.r = r;
          sq.dataset.c = c;

          // Coordinate labels
          if (c === 0) {
            const rankLabel = document.createElement('span');
            rankLabel.className = 'coord coord-rank';
            rankLabel.innerText = 8 - r;
            sq.appendChild(rankLabel);
          }
          if (r === 7) {
            const fileLabel = document.createElement('span');
            fileLabel.className = 'coord coord-file';
            fileLabel.innerText = String.fromCharCode(97 + c);
            sq.appendChild(fileLabel);
          }

          // Selected highlight
          if (selectedSquare && selectedSquare.r === r && selectedSquare.c === c) {
            sq.classList.add('selected');
          }

          // King in check red highlight
          if (kPos && kPos.r === r && kPos.c === c) {
            sq.classList.add('in-check');
          }

          // Piece
          const p = game.board[r][c];
          if (p && PIECE_SVGS[p]) {
            const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
            wrapper.className = 'mh-piece-wrapper';
            wrapper.innerHTML = PIECE_SVGS[p];
            sq.appendChild(wrapper);
          }

          // Move hint
          const moveMatch = validMoves.find(m => m.to.r === r && m.to.c === c);
          if (moveMatch) {
            const hint = document.createElement('div');
            hint.className = moveMatch.isCapture ? 'capture-hint' : 'move-hint';
            sq.appendChild(hint);
          }

          sq.addEventListener('click', () => onSquareClick(r, c));
          boardEl.appendChild(sq);
        }
      }

      updateStatusUI();
    }

    function onSquareClick(r, c) {
      const p = game.board[r][c];
      const pColor = game.getColor(p);

      // If clicked on own piece: select it
      if (p && pColor === game.turn) {
        selectedSquare = { r, c };
        validMoves = game.getLegalMoves(r, c);
        renderBoard();
        return;
      }

      // If a piece is already selected, check if clicked square is a valid target
      if (selectedSquare) {
        const targetMove = validMoves.find(m => m.to.r === r && m.to.c === c);
        if (targetMove) {
          if (targetMove.isPromo) {
            pendingPromoMove = targetMove;
            openPromoModal();
          } else {
            executeMove(targetMove);
          }
          return;
        }
      }

      // Otherwise deselect
      selectedSquare = null;
      validMoves = [];
      renderBoard();
    }

    function executeMove(move, promoChoice = 'Q') {
      const res = game.makeMove(move, promoChoice);
      selectedSquare = null;
      validMoves = [];

      // Audio feedback
      if (res.status === 'checkmate') {
        audio.playFanfare();
      } else if (res.inCheck) {
        audio.playCheck();
      } else if (res.captured) {
        audio.playCapture();
      } else {
        audio.playMove();
      }

      // Commentary flavor
      const pType = (move.isPromo ? promoChoice : res.piece).toUpperCase();
      let comment = '';
      if (res.status === 'checkmate') {
        const winner = game.turn === 'w' ? 'Shadow Apex (Black)' : 'Guild Expedition (White)';
        comment = `🏆 QUEST COMPLETE! ${winner} triumph in the Forbidden Lands!`;
      } else if (res.inCheck) {
        comment = COMMENTARY.check[Math.floor(Math.random() * COMMENTARY.check.length)];
      } else if (res.captured) {
        comment = COMMENTARY.capture[Math.floor(Math.random() * COMMENTARY.capture.length)];
      } else if (COMMENTARY[pType]) {
        const arr = COMMENTARY[pType];
        comment = arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];
      }
      commentaryBanner.innerText = comment;

      // Auto-rotate if enabled
      if (chkAutoRotate.checked) {
        isFlipped = (game.turn === 'b');
        boardContainer.classList.toggle('flipped', isFlipped);
      }

      renderBoard();

      if (res.status === 'checkmate') {
        const winner = game.turn === 'w' ? 'Shadow Apex (Black)' : 'Guild Expedition (White)';
        gameOverTitle.innerText = '🏆 QUEST COMPLETE!';
        gameOverMsg.innerText = `${winner} win the expedition! The Forbidden Lands have been conquered.`;
        gameOverModal.style.display = 'flex';
      } else if (res.status === 'stalemate') {
        gameOverTitle.innerText = '⛺ CAMP CEASEFIRE!';
        gameOverMsg.innerText = 'Neither side can make a move! Both sides retreat to base camp.';
        gameOverModal.style.display = 'flex';
      }
    }

    function openPromoModal() {
      promoGrid.innerHTML = '';
      const color = game.turn;
      const options = color === 'w' ? [
        { key: 'Q', title: 'Arkveld (Queen)' },
        { key: 'R', title: 'Doshaguma (Rook)' },
        { key: 'N', title: 'Seikret Mount (Knight)' },
        { key: 'B', title: 'Rey Dau (Bishop)' }
      ] : [
        { key: 'q', title: 'Arkveld (Queen)' },
        { key: 'r', title: 'Doshaguma (Rook)' },
        { key: 'n', title: 'Seikret Mount (Knight)' },
        { key: 'b', title: 'Rey Dau (Bishop)' }
      ];

      options.forEach(opt => {
        const optKey = opt.key;
        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'promo-option';
        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="promo-svg">${PIECE_SVGS[optKey]}</div>
          <div class="promo-label">${opt.title}</div>
        `;
        card.addEventListener('click', () => {
          promoModal.style.display = 'none';
          if (pendingPromoMove) {
            const move = pendingPromoMove;
            pendingPromoMove = null;
            executeMove(move, opt.key.toUpperCase());
          }
        });
        promoGrid.appendChild(card);
      });

      promoModal.style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function updateStatusUI() {
      const isWhiteTurn = game.turn === 'w';
      turnText.innerText = isWhiteTurn ? "Guild Expedition's Turn ⚔️" : "Shadow Apex's Turn 🐉";
      turnAvatar.className = `player-avatar ${isWhiteTurn ? '' : 'black-team'}`;
      turnAvatar.innerHTML = isWhiteTurn ? PIECE_SVGS['K'] : PIECE_SVGS['k'];

      const inCheck = game.isCheck(game.turn);
      checkBadge.style.display = inCheck ? 'inline-block' : 'none';

      // Update captured trays
      whiteCapturedTray.innerHTML = game.capturedWhite.map(p => `<div class="captured-icon">${PIECE_SVGS[p]}</div>`).join('');
      blackCapturedTray.innerHTML = game.capturedBlack.map(p => `<div class="captured-icon">${PIECE_SVGS[p]}</div>`).join('');
    }

    // Event Listeners
    document.getElementById('btnFlip').addEventListener('click', () => {
      isFlipped = !isFlipped;
      boardContainer.classList.toggle('flipped', isFlipped);
    });

    document.getElementById('btnUndo').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const undone = game.undo();
      if (undone) {
        selectedSquare = null;
        validMoves = [];
        commentaryBanner.innerText = '↩️ Tactical retreat! Turn rolled back.';
        if (chkAutoRotate.checked) {
          isFlipped = (game.turn === 'b');
          boardContainer.classList.toggle('flipped', isFlipped);
        }
        renderBoard();
      }
    });

    document.getElementById('btnNewGame').addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (confirm('Embark on a new Monster Hunter Wilds chess match?')) {
        game.reset();
        selectedSquare = null;
        validMoves = [];
        isFlipped = false;
        boardContainer.classList.remove('flipped');
        commentaryBanner.innerText = '⚔️ Fresh hunt initialized! Guild Expedition (White) to move.';
        gameOverModal.style.display = 'none';
        renderBoard();
      }
    });

    document.getElementById('btnPlayAgain').addEventListener('click', () => {
      game.reset();
      selectedSquare = null;
      validMoves = [];
      isFlipped = false;
      boardContainer.classList.remove('flipped');
      commentaryBanner.innerText = '⚔️ Fresh hunt initialized! Guild Expedition (White) to move.';
      gameOverModal.style.display = 'none';
      renderBoard();
    });

    const btnSound = document.getElementById('btnSound');
    btnSound.addEventListener('click', () => {
      audio.enabled = !audio.enabled;
      btnSound.innerText = audio.enabled ? '🔊 Sound' : '🔇 Muted';
    });

    // Initial render
    renderBoard();
